description: This Java source file defines the class JMSMessageWorkaround, a subclass of JmsMessage, which acts as a wrapper to override and disable certain setter methods in JMS messages, specifically to prevent the Qpid client from setting AMQP properties arbitrarily. It provides mechanisms to wrap existing JMS messages and delegate calls while overriding specific behaviors.

classes.name: JMSMessageWorkaround
classes.description: A wrapper subclass of JmsMessage designed to override setter methods so they do not modify internal state, preventing the Qpid JMS client from arbitrarily setting AMQP properties.
